subject: POC playbook: kickoff timing, hands-on split, and quota request
messages:
From: Rachael Gomez <rachael.gomez@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightLeaf POC: kickoff and capacity planning

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We'd like to lock in a POC kickoff and a hands-on working session to go through prompt review, routing profiles, and a short load test. Our stakeholders are available the week of Aug 24-28; preferred kickoff days are Aug 24 or 25. Key asks:
- 60–90 min kickoff (intro + prompt review + routing overview)
- 90 min hands-on to run load tests (simulate 50k–100k tokens/day, peak TPS ~5-8)
- Clarify Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation for the trial and whether we can get a temporary quota bump (tokens/day) and a short TPS increase for the test window

I've attached BrightLeaf's requirements packet.

Best,
Rachael
Rachael Gomez
Director, Product Ops
BrightLeaf Health
Attachments: brightleaf_requirements.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Rachael Gomez <rachael.gomez@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf POC: kickoff and capacity planning

Hi Rachael — great to hear. We can do a kickoff the week of Aug 24; I propose Aug 24, 10:00–11:00 PT for the formal kickoff (60 min). Proposed agenda:
- 10m intros and goals/metrics for success
- 20m prompt review + quality baselines
- 15m routing/variant discussion (Quiet vs Aggressive routing + KV cache expectations)
- 15m logistics (quota, rate limits, Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation)

Separately we should schedule a hands-on load test session (90 min) where we'll run the 50k–100k token/day simulation and peak TPS checks. Marcus — can you own the load test script and estimate how much spot quota we'll need? Mina — please prepare the routing profiles and a brief on fallback policies.

I'm attaching our POC playbook (draft) and a short checklist so we can confirm pre-reqs. If Aug 24 doesn't work on your side, let me know and we'll shift.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: poc_playbook_v1.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf POC: kickoff and capacity planning

Tessa — I can take the load test. Quick notes: 
- I'll build a parametric load script (attached draft) that can simulate prompt mixes and token counts. For a realistic surface test targeting 50k tokens/day with 5–8 TPS peaks we should request a temporary quota bump to ~200k tokens/day for the trial window to allow for retries and parallel flows.
- For TPS, Hosted endpoints usually handle bursts fine but if BrightLeaf needs sustained higher TPS we should run the hands-on against a Dedicated pool or a Hosted instance with an increased concurrency bucket.
- Can we get a 2-hour window (not necessarily contiguous) to do warm-up + steady-state sampling? That helps kernel selection and KV warm caches.

Attaching loadtest_script_v2.py (draft).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Performance Eng, Redwood Inference
Attachments: loadtest_script_v2.py

From: Rachael Gomez <rachael.gomez@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightleafhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-20T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf POC: kickoff and capacity planning

Hi Tessa and team — apologies, a stakeholder conflict just came up. Can we move the formal kickoff to Aug 26? If possible we'd like to keep the kickoff shorter (60 min) and push the full hands-on load test to later in the week (Aug 27 or Aug 28) so our engineering folks can attend.

Also a couple clarifying Qs:
- When you say "temporary quota bump to ~200k tokens/day" — is that an admin change we need to sign off on or something you handle on Redwood's side?
- For TPS increases during test windows, do we need to commit to Dedicated, or can Hosted be configured for a short high-TPS window?

Thanks — Rachael

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Rachael Gomez <rachael.gomez@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf POC: kickoff and capacity planning

Thanks for the heads-up, Rachael — Aug 26 works for us. Proposal:
- Kickoff: Aug 26, 09:00–10:00 PT (60 min) — intros, goals, prompt review, routing overview, and a short ops checklist.
- Hands-on load test: Aug 28, 09:00–10:30 PT (90 min) — Marcus will run the script and we'll gather steady-state metrics + token accounting.

Operational notes and next steps:
- Quota bump: Redwood can provision a temporary token quota increase for the trial window once procurement signs the SOW/NDA. That is an admin action we coordinate with our platform team (no code changes on BrightLeaf). Estimated request: 200k tokens/day for the week of testing; I'll open the request today.
- TPS bump: For short, high-TPS windows (30–120 minutes), Hosted is feasible if we schedule it and route traffic through a transient higher-concurrency bucket. If BrightLeaf wants guaranteed sustained TPS for production-like stress, Dedicated is the recommended path. For this POC we suggest Hosted with a scheduled TPS bump; if the hands-on shows sustained needs we'll propose a Dedicated trial for the next phase.
- Pre-reqs: please confirm test account IP allowlist and whether you'll share a sample prompt set (we attached a short prompt template in the playbook).

I've opened the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://hubspot.com/deals/DL-15823 and mirrored the POC playbook here: https://drive.redwood.ai/poc-playbook/brightleaf.

If that's acceptable, Marcus and Mina will join the kickoff and we'll confirm the quota ticket number prior to Aug 26.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Contact: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

From: Rachael Gomez <rachael.gomez@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightleafhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf POC: kickoff and capacity planning

Perfect — Aug 26 (09:00 PT) is confirmed and Aug 28 for the load test works. I've added our eng leads (cc'd) and procurement will review the SOW/NDA; attaching the signed NDA for now. We will also share a sample prompt set by EOD Monday so you can pre-seed any caches you need.

Looking forward — Rachael
Attachments: brightleaf_signed_nda.pdf
